onset.Description: Start of the trial segment in the concatenated file

duration.Description: Segment length (12 s: -4.999 to +7.000 s around the alignment event)

trial_type.Description: Alignment of this file (acq entity): onset, decision, trig3, trig4, trig5

sample.Description: First sample (0-based) of the trial segment

trial_index.Description: 1-based trial number (row of the released high_gamma_mat)

time_zero_onset.Description: Time of the alignment event (column 5000 of the released matrix)

choice.Description: subject(n).decision, verbatim (renamed: 'decision' is a reserved BIDS column)

Levels.2: value 2 occurs in the release and is not described in the README; the authors' code keeps trials with decision < 2

reward_trial.Description: Reward offer on the trial (number of lit treasures)

punish_trial.Description: Punishment offer on the trial (number of lit bombs)

p_approach_trial.Description: Subject's overall approach probability for this trial type

conflict_trial.Description: Subject's behavioural conflict for this trial type

value_trial.Description: subject(n).value_trial, verbatim (not documented in the README)

source_trigger1.Description: subject(n).triggers(1) value for this trial, verbatim (sample index in the original recording; units not stated in the release)

source_trigger2.Description: subject(n).triggers(2) value for this trial, verbatim (sample index in the original recording; units not stated in the release)

source_trigger3.Description: subject(n).triggers(3) value for this trial, verbatim (sample index in the original recording; units not stated in the release)

source_trigger4.Description: subject(n).triggers(4) value for this trial, verbatim (sample index in the original recording; units not stated in the release)

source_trigger5.Description: subject(n).triggers(5) value for this trial, verbatim (sample index in the original recording; units not stated in the release)
